DeepSight Technology | Software Manager x2, Staff Software Engineer (GPU Algorithms), C++ Software Engineers | Santa Clara, CA (Hybrid) | $175k-$250k (some flex) | Full-time | https://deepsightinc.applicantpro.com/jobs/

DeepSight is transforming interventional imaging. Our proprietary NeedleVue™ platform delivers real-time visualization inside the body — showing target anatomy and instrument position together — to guide biopsies, ablations, and cardiac interventions with radiation-free precision.

Our mission: democratize procedural medicine. 85% of U.S. counties lack skilled procedural specialists, and our low-cost platform helps close that gap with faster, safer cancer diagnosis and treatment.

Hiring: Software Manager (x2) (Imaging and AI, and GUI and App Logic), Staff Software Engineer — GPU Algorithms, C++ Software Engineers.

Apply: email CV to reverly@deepsight.com with "Hacker News" in the subject line.
